content: Ngani ja kwajangatilanga bhangi

Ayesu bhakapunda kulongela, “Ntamange maha, nkotokutendanga hikubho yinu yammbone kupala bhandu bhannolange. Kwakubhee handa mpakutendanga henela jaakwa ngwahupa kubhoka kwa Atati bhinu bhabhabhii kunani kwa Annoongo.”

“Bahi, pamwajangatila chilebhe ahocho, nkotokulobhola kwa bhandu. Nkotokutenda handa andendemundu chibhatendanga mu Nyuumba ja konganilana Bhayuhudi na nndela ligongo lya bhandu bhalumbalilwe. Ndendakunnobholelanga kweli bhenabho bhatekupatanga ngwahupa jabhenji.
Nambo mwenga pampakwaapekea chilebhe ahocho, ntende henela hata aganja bhinu bhabhammandikile bhakotokuhimanya chintenda.
Henela ngani hejo jipakubhee jakuchiiya kwaachinu, na Atati jwinu jwaalola gantendite kwa kuchiiya, bhapakumpekea ngwahupa.”
Majigano nnani ja kujopa

“Mwangota pantendanga kujopa, nkotokutenda handa andendemundu. Bhena angota bhapala kujema na kujopa Mu Nyuumba ja konganilana Bhayuhudi kuntundu ja ndela ligongo lya bhandu bhabhalolange. Ndendakunnobholelanga kweli, bhenaangota bhatekupatanga ngwahupa jabhenji.
Nambo mwenga pannyopa Annoongo, nnyingile mu chuumba chinu nchitabhile nnyango, ngapena mwajope Atati bhinu bhangabhonekana. Na bhena bhabhagabhona gagatekuchiia bhapakunpekea ngwahupa.”
“Na mwangota pantenda kujopanga, nkotokulobhola kwa malobhe gajingi handa bhandu bhangaamanya Annoongo. Bhena angota bhaganikia yakubhee Annoongo bhapakwaajohanikia ligongo lya malobhe gajingi.
Nkotokubhee handa bhenabho, kwa kubhee Atati bhinu bhagamanya mumugapala hata kabula mwangaajopa.
Bahi, henela nga chiipalikwa kujopa,

content.text: ‘Atati bhitu bhammile kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo,
Upalyo gwinu gutendeke pamba pachilambo handa kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo.
Ntupekee leleni chakulya chitu cha machobha goa.
handa na twenga chitutenda kwaalekelela bhabhatulemwite.
nambo ntulolekee kubhoka kwa bhenibhala abohu. Kwa kubhee Umwenye nga gwinu, na machili na ng'anyimo hata machobha goa. Elo.’”

content: “Ligongo handa mwalekejelinge bhandu kulemwa kwabhenji chibhantendile, na atati bhinu bha kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo nga chibhapakunlekelela na mwangota.
Nambo handa mwangaalekelela bhandu kulemwa kwabhenji, na bhenabho Atati bhinu bha kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo bhannekelelanga hopo kulemwa kwinu.”
Majigano nnani ja kutabha

Ayesu akapunda kulobhola, “Pampakutabha nkotokuhumalika handa akaandendemundu. Bhenaangota bhatenda kubheka lukenja pamiho jabhe ligongo bhabhonekane na bhandu kubhee bhatabhite. Nannobholelanga kweli, bhena angota bhatekupatanga ngwahupa jabhenji.
Nambo mwenga pamtenda kutabha, nkue pamihon jinu na mpakale mahuta mu mutwe gwinu na mkwemule majunju ginu,
kubhee amundu bhoa bhala bhakoto kuhimanya yakubhehe ntabhite, ila bhamanyike tu kwa Atati bhabhe bhangabhonekana. Na bhenabho Atati bhinu bhabhabhona gachiite bhapakunpekea ngwahupa.”
Tuchibhekele ngokwe kunani kwa Annoongo
Ayesu akapunda kwaalobholelanga, “Nkoto kuchibhekela hilebhe pambani pachilambo hikoko ya bhakuhalabiana na kuutu bhatenda kombola kujingila na kuhalabiana na akaabwihi kujingila na kujibha.
Nchibhekele hilebhe kulihunde kwa Annoongo kwa kubhee hikoko na kuutu ngakombola kuhalibiana wala akaabwihi ngakombola kujiingila na kujibha.
Maana penipala pajibhile ngokwe jinu, ngapena kabhele pagupakubhee ntima gwinu.”
Lumuli lwa mmele
“Lio nga lumuli gwa mmele. Handa lio linu nga likoto, mmele gwinu goa gupakubhehe pa nhana.
Nambo handa lio linu nga libhou, mmele gwinu goa gupakubhee mu lubhendu. Bahi, handa nhana gugubhile nkati jinu nga lubhendu, bahi gonogwe nga lubhendu lwa kujogoa!”
Annoongo na hilebhe

“Ayesu akaalobholela bhaakwa amundu bhakombola kwaatumikila akaakolo bhabhele. Kwa kubhee bhapakwaachimwa bhamo na kwaapala bhenabho jwabhele, au bhapakubhee na bhamo na kwaabhelua bhenabho bhangi. Ngakombolanga kwaatumikila Annoongo pamo na hilebhe.”

“Nga kwa maana nannobholelanga, nkoto kubhee na lipamba kwa ngani ja chakulya chichimpakulyee na ching'welo chichimpakung'wee, wala ngani ja ngobho yakuwala mu mimele jinunji. Bholi, umomi nga chakulya jikajabhe au kupunda echocho? Na mmele, bholi nga kupunda ngobho?
Muilolange hijuni. Ngapandanga na kuuna, wala bhangakola ngokwe joha jela. Hata henela Atati bhinu bha kunani kwa Annoongo bhapakunpekea yakulyee. Bholi, mwangota ngabha bhammbone kupunda hijuni?
Nga aganiki nkati jinunji kwa kuchilagia bhakombola kuchijonjokea kutandamala kwabhe hata lichaa limo lya kutama kwabhe?”
“Ngani ja ngobho, ya niki kubhee na lipamba? Mugalolange malobha ga kumanyahi chigapunda kuhalala. Gateendahopo lihengo wala kuchihalakia ngobho.
Nambo ndendakunnobholelanga, hata Asolomoni bheene na kukola kwabhe hilebhe koha Annoongo bhangaaweka maha handa lilobha limo lyabhe lya gangani.

Bahi, ikabhee Annoongo bhakagawekela mahamba ga kunng'onda, yakubhee leleni gabhile, malabhi gatenda kujoma na kulekelwa pamooto, bholi, ngabha bhapakuntendelanga maha muno? Bholi, mwangota mwangahobhalelanga!”
“Bahi, nkotokubhee na lipamba, ‘Tupakulyee niki?’ Au kabhele, ‘Tupakung'wee niki?’ Au ‘Tupakuwala niki!’
Kwa kubhee genago goa gatenda kulolekewa na bhandu bhangaamanya Annoongo. Atati bhitu abhile kunani kwa Anoongo atenda kuhimanya hilebhe yoha tuhipala.
Henela, nnyemekange kugulolekea Umwenye gwa Annoongo kupeta yoha na gaagapala Annoongo, na Annoongo bhapakumpekea genago goa na kunnyonjokeanga.
Bahi, nkotokubhee na lipamba nnani ja malabhi, kwa kubhee malabhi jitekubhee na hilebhe yabhe. Kila lichobha litekubhee na hilebhe ya lichobha elyo.”
